candidate: one post-tail rigid relocation of a weak OOF-classified realised supply-graph bridge subtree
control: exact frozen confirmed selective plus unique-fullres six-arm fusion final layout
classifier: reuse only the fixed 27 context-protector features and unweighted logistic model; classifier does not order edges or change a solver supply
model: StandardScaler plus unweighted LogisticRegression(C=1, lbfgs, max_iter=1000, random_state=0)
weak_bridge_definition: an already realised focal-positive selected-supply edge with p < 0.5 whose removal disconnects its endpoints in the undirected realised-edge graph
movable_subtree: one side of a weak bridge cut, only if it contains at least two tiles and no tile incident to any p >= 0.5 realised edge
high_confidence_core: all endpoints of realised edges with p >= 0.5; their board positions are immutable
move: enumerate all nonzero rigid translations of each eligible subtree that remain on 24x24 board and do not enter a core position; preserve internal geometry and use existing local bijective fill only for non-core displaced tiles
selection: at most one candidate: strictly minimum unchanged original all-1104-bond raw seam cost; ties lower bridge p, larger subtree, frozen edge order, then row-major translation
fallback: return frozen six-arm final control bit-for-bit if no strictly improving feasible move exists
local_prediction: validation source is predicted by a model fitted only on other source groups
prohibited_adaptation: threshold, bridge, subtree-size, weight, tie-break, cost-gain, feature, model, class-weight, or gate sweep
relation-vote shift restriction or component-anchor objective reuse
matcher, denoiser, supply, solver, tail, or pre-tail layout rerun
